dog.description_text:
Stripey is a sweet and loving boy who has adjusted beautifully to life indoors and is enjoying all the comforts that come with it. His favorite pastimes include birdwatching from the windows, curling up in his cozy bed, and enjoying a good meal.

Stripey feels safest and most secure in his bed, where he happily welcomes all the pets and affection you have to offer. While he can be shy at first, he's also quite the conversationalist and is quick to show his affectionate side.

Stripey may look a little different, but his unique appearance is just one small part of what makes him special. His gentle nature, endearing personality, and sweet disposition are sure to win you over. All he needs is someone who can see past his appearance and give him the loving forever home he so deserves.
dog.name: Stripey
